hotspots.title: Jair Bolsonaro Hospitalized with Severe Intestinal Obstruction
hotspots.blurb: Former Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro remains in the ICU in Brasília after suffering a severe abdominal obstruction and developing bilateral aspiration pneumonia. Medical updates report he experienced acute distress following bouts of vomiting while under home confinement, drawing intense health monitoring.
hotspots.affect: The medical emergency surrounding the former president triggers deep existential alarm among his base, combining victimhood framing, health panic, and intense political symbolism.

hotspots.title: Vox 29N Campaign Launch & Remigration Push
hotspots.blurb: With Spain's November 29 snap elections rapidly approaching, Vox is driving coverage with aggressive proposals demanding national preference, major tax cuts, and strict remigration policies. Party leadership continues to pressure the Popular Party (PP) over post-election coalition conditions while framing the vote as a crucial battle against Pedro Sánchez.
hotspots.affect: The high-stakes election countdown produces intense polarized contention as Vox's uncompromising stance on remigration and governance creates friction both with left-wing opponents and conservative allies.

hotspots.title: Trump Attacks Newsom Over California Death Row Commutations
hotspots.blurb: Donald Trump launched a sharp assault against California Governor Gavin Newsom during a high-profile press conference at the Department of Justice, surrounded by families of crime victims. Trump condemned Newsom's decision to commute over 500 death row sentences, calling it a shocking betrayal of public safety and justice.
hotspots.affect: By directly leveraging grieving families and law-and-order outrage, the story heavily relies on visceral moral charge and high-conflict partisan staging ahead of future presidential matchups.

hotspots.title: RN Headquarters Raided in State Leaks Probe
hotspots.blurb: Rassemblement National is weathering dual controversies as police raids target its headquarters over alleged state security leaks while party president Jordan Bardella scrambles to control damage from past antisemitic posts by executive Laure Lavalette. Bardella has publicly conceded Lavalette made a 'mistake' while simultaneously dismissing the judicial probe as a suspicious political setup.
hotspots.affect: The convergence of antisemitism scandals and judicial raids puts the party in a defensive combat mode, activating anti-establishment grievance and conspiracy-coded defenses among supporters.

hotspots.title: AfD Escalates Deportation Demands at Party Congresses
hotspots.blurb: Alternative for Germany (AfD) leadership, including Alice Weidel and Maximilian Krah, has intensified calls for the large-scale expulsion of up to 2.6 million migrants, refugees, and foreign nationals. The aggressive push comes alongside threats from party leaders to file constitutional challenges against the national budget over state spending.
hotspots.affect: Mass deportation rhetoric triggers high affective charge by tapping into demographic existential fears, drawing acute outrage from political opponents and media commentators alike.
